verdict.rationale: Superhuman's Ask AI feature directly supports natural-language Q&A grounded in the inbox and calendar (e.g., 'where is the q2 offsite', 'when is my flight', 'where am I staying'), and the MCP integration extends this to Claude/ChatGPT for cross-inbox/calendar queries, drafting, and scheduling grounded in real data. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence validating accuracy of 'grounded answers' across a full inbox+calendar corpus, and detail on how well it surfaces 'what's outstanding' beyond follow-up reminders.
